column1: An Invention That Changed the World

column1: In ancient China, many different materials were used to write on, such as animal bones, bronze ware, stones, wood, bamboo, and even silk.
column2: 在古代中国，人们在许多不同的材料上写字，比如兽骨、青铜器、石头、木头、竹子，甚至丝绸。

column1: In the Western Han Dynasty, there was also a very early form of paper made from jute—a fibre that comes from plants.
column2: 西汉时期，还有一种非常早期的纸，是用黄麻做的——黄麻是一种来自植物的纤维。

column1: However, all of these materials were either difficult to use and store, or very expensive.
column2: 然而，所有这些材料要么难以使用和保存，要么非常昂贵。

column1: As the head officer of the palace workshop for the emperor in the Eastern Han Dynasty, Cai Lun became interested in trying to solve the problem.
column2: 东汉时期，蔡伦作为为皇帝掌管宫廷作坊的长官，开始想办法解决这个问题。

column2: 人们尝试了各种方法来制造可以写字的东西，但都不理想。

column2: 在他那个时代，有些树皮——也就是树的外层——被用来做衣服。

column1: From past experiences, Cai Lun got the idea that bark, certain plants, and old clothes could be used to make a special material suitable to write on.
column2: 根据以往的经验，蔡伦想到，树皮、某些植物和旧衣服可以用来制作一种适合写字的特殊材料。

column1: In the first step of Cai Lun's experiment, all the ingredients were mixed and boiled in water.
column2: 在蔡伦实验的第一步，所有原料被混合在一起放进水里煮。

column1: Then, this material was beaten, cut up, and mixed with water again.
column2: 然后，把这些材料捶打、切碎，再和水混合。

column2: 接着，把液体倒在竹帘上，只留下纤维。

column1: Finally, this fibre was dried and pressed to form paper.
column2: 最后，把这些纤维晾干、压平，就成了纸。

column1: He has not walked for years because he thinks he has an illness.
column2: 他好几年没走路了，因为他觉得自己有病。

column1: Mary and Dickon tell him stories about the garden and take him secretly to see it.
column2: 玛丽和迪康给他讲花园的故事，还偷偷带他去看。

column1: Over time, Colin grows stronger.
column2: 随着时间推移，科林变得越来越强壮。

column1: The fresh air and beautiful garden are good for him, and he proves that he is not ill when he gets to his feet for the first time in years!
column2: 新鲜的空气和美丽的花园对他有好处，当他多年来第一次站起来时，他证明了自己没有病！

column1: The three friends spend time together in the garden and grow happier day by day.
column2: 三个朋友在花园里一起度过时光，一天比一天快乐。

column1: In the end, Mary's uncle returns home.
column2: 最后，玛丽的姑父回到了家。

column1: To his great surprise, he sees Colin walking and running, and he discovers that the secret garden has become as alive and beautiful as it ever was!
column2: 让他非常惊讶的是，他看到科林在走、在跑，还发现秘密花园变得和从前一样生机勃勃、美丽动人！

column1: Excuse me,
are you a volunteer here?

column1: Oh, I've been a volunteer since last year.

I help the players and give directions.

column1: Sir, are you a volunteer here at the art museum?
column2: 先生，您是这家美术馆的志愿者吗？

column1: May I know what you do?
column2: 我可以问问您做什么吗？

column1: I guide visitors through the museum and provide information about the paintings.
column2: 我带参观者游览美术馆，介绍这些画。

column1: You see, I'm studying art history at university.
column2: 你看，我在大学学艺术史。

column1: That's a good use of your skills!
column2: 这样很好地发挥了你的专长！

column1: How long have you been a volunteer at the museum?
column2: 你在美术馆做志愿者多久了？

column1: Well, I've only been a guide here for two weeks.
column2: 嗯，我在这里当讲解员才两周。

column1: Let's talk to one of the volunteers with the beach clean-up organization.
column2: 我们去和海滩清洁组织的一位志愿者聊聊吧。

column1: Excuse me, Miss.
How is the clean-up going?
column2: 清洁工作进展得怎么样？

column1: It's going well!
I've picked up three bags of bottles and cans since our team arrived this morning.
column2: 从今天早上我们团队到这里以来，我已经捡了三袋瓶子和罐子。

column1: You've worked hard!
Have you been a volunteer with the organization for long?
column2: 你在这个组织做志愿者很久了吗？

column1: Yes, for about seven years.
You must really care about the beach.
column2: 你一定很爱护这片海滩。

column1: Yes, I think it's everyone's duty to look after it!
column2: 是的，我认为保护它是每个人的责任！

column1: Wow! You must really care about the beach.
column2: 哇！你一定很爱护这片海滩。

column1: Hi, Robert.
What are you watching?
Oh, it's a show about volunteering.
column2: 哦，是一个关于志愿服务的节目。

column1: It's quite inspiring!
Hey, I've watched that before.
Did it inspire you to volunteer?
column2: 它激励你去做志愿者了吗？

column1: Yeah. In fact, I've been a volunteer at an animal shelter for two years now.
column2: 是的。事实上，我在一家动物收容所做志愿者已经两年了。

column1: Wow! What do you do there?
Well, I clean the cages and feed the animals
And I look after the new dogs.
Some of them are in poor condition and need more care!
column2: 有些狗状况很差，需要更多的照顾！

column1: And I collect donations for the shelter too.
column2: 我还为收容所收集捐赠物。

column1: Goodness!
Hey, do you need help?
Can I volunteer too?
Have you ever been to our animal shelter, Robert?
column2: 罗伯特，你来过我们的动物收容所吗？

column1: No, I haven't,
but my friend Rose has told me all about it.
column2: 但我的朋友罗丝都跟我讲过了。

column1: Have you taken care of animals before?
I had a dog when I was young.
I walked her, and I filled her food and water bowls.
column2: 我遛她，给她的碗添食物和水。

column1: Because of her, I learnt that every animal is special and needs love.
column2: 因为她，我懂得了每只动物都很特别，都需要爱。

column1: You're right!
Now, how often can you volunteer?
column2: 那么，你多久能来做一次志愿者？

column1: About once a week?
Perfect!
What do you do there?
What are your plans for the summer vacation?
I think I'll do some volunteer work at a nursing home with my youth group.
column2: 我想我会和青年团的伙伴们去养老院做些志愿工作。

column1: I've been a volunteer there since last year.
column2: 我从去年开始就在那里做志愿者。

column1: Oh! What do you do?
I exercise with the elderly to help them stay active.
column2: 我和老人们一起锻炼，帮助他们保持活力。

column1: Sometimes I play Chinese chess with them.
column2: 有时我和他们下中国象棋。

column1: I've even taught some of them how to use a mobile phone.
column2: 我甚至教过一些老人怎样用手机。

column1: That's great.
Do their families visit them often?
column2: 他们的家人常来看他们吗？

column1: Some do, but not all.
column2: 有些常来，但不是所有人。

column1: Many elderly people are very lonely.
That makes me sad.
We'll all be old one day too.
It's important to care for the elderly.
You know, they actually have so many interesting life stories and experiences to share with us.
column2: 你知道，他们其实有很多有趣的人生故事和经历可以和我们分享。

column1: Can I join your group of volunteers?
column2: 我能加入你们的志愿者小组吗？

column1: I'd love to help.
come along!
It's fun to volunteer together.

column1: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for inviting me to speak to you about Blue Sky Rescue today.
column2: 女士们，先生们，谢谢你们今天邀请我来介绍蓝天救援队。

column1: Let me begin with my own story.
column2: 让我从我自己的故事讲起。

column1: Back in 2008, I was hiking in the mountains with some friends when one of them fell and got a bad head injury.
column2: 2008年，我和几个朋友在山里徒步时，其中一个人摔倒了，头部受了重伤。

column1: We had to find help quickly, so we called an emergency number.
column2: 我们必须尽快找到帮助，于是拨打了急救电话。

column1: It was already dark, and we couldn't even see where we were.
column2: 天已经黑了，我们甚至看不清自己在哪里。

column1: After some time, we heard dogs barking and the voices of the Blue Sky Rescue team. I nearly started crying.
column2: 过了一会儿，我们听到了狗叫声和蓝天救援队队员的声音。我差点哭了出来。

column1: We were so thankful that they found us!
column2: 他们找到了我们，我们真是太感激了！

column1: I've never forgotten that day.
Since then, I've wanted to help others too.
column2: 从那以后，我也想帮助别人。

column1: I signed up with Blue Sky Rescue in 2009, and I've been a volunteer ever since.
column2: 我在2009年报名加入了蓝天救援队，从那以后一直是一名志愿者。

column1: We've been to schools and other communities to teach children and adults how to stay safe and prepare for the worst.
column2: 我们去学校和其他社区，教孩子和大人如何保护自己、为最坏的情况做准备。

column1: We've also rescued people during emergencies.
column2: 我们还在紧急情况下救援过人们。

column1: We've provided medical aid and searched for missing people after natural disasters, like the 2013 earthquake in Ya'an and the typhoon in the Philippines in the same year.
column2: 我们在自然灾害后提供医疗援助、搜寻失踪人员，比如2013年的雅安地震和同年的菲律宾台风。

column1: In 2023, we even helped in places as far away as Türkiye!
column2: 2023年，我们甚至在远至土耳其的地方提供了帮助！

column1: Working as a volunteer has taught me many practical life-saving skills.
column2: 做志愿者教会了我许多实用的救生技能。

column1: It has also helped me understand the power of teamwork because it's the key to successful rescues.
column2: 它还让我明白了团队合作的力量，因为这是救援成功的关键。

column1: Most of all, being a volunteer has taught me the value of every life.
column2: 最重要的是，做志愿者让我懂得了每个生命的价值。

column1: The work is difficult.
It's voluntary, so we aren't paid.
column2: 这是自愿的，所以我们没有报酬。

column1: We often go without food or sleep.
column2: 我们常常顾不上吃饭睡觉。

column1: But our primary goal has always been to save as many people as we can.
column2: 但我们的首要目标始终是尽可能多地救人。

column1: I'm just an ordinary person, but I'll rush into danger, just like everyone else in Blue Sky Rescue.
column2: 我只是一个普通人，但我会冲向危险，就像蓝天救援队的其他人一样。

column1: To the people we've saved and their loved ones, I know we're their heroes. And that makes everything we do worth it.
column2: 对于我们救过的人和他们的亲人，我知道我们是他们的英雄。这让我们做的一切都值得。

column1: We want to do even more, but we can't do it all alone.
column2: 我们想做得更多，但我们不能单打独斗。

column1: Will you join us as a volunteer?
column2: 你愿意作为志愿者加入我们吗？

column1: Together we can make a difference!
column2: 我们一起就能带来改变！
